data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month and invite each of you to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. Fisher15/17/24/13, please help recruit. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). All18 leaves50; next is500 or100—not risk-free or guaranteed best long-run. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation. Each: exact intended catch, and does it depend on others?
